what: The photo-cell row stands still for 1.2 seconds, then slides exactly one cell over 1.65 seconds with cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), and repeats endlessly. It is not a flowing marquee but a ‹stop, go› tempo. With two rows set to opposite dir they pass each other as if walking through a showroom complex, and with axis: y it becomes a vertical column rising one cell at a time (phone). A copy of the set is cloned behind, and when it has all moved it quietly jumps back to the start position

options.hold: Rest time standing on one step (seconds), default 1.2 — original phone vertical column 1
options.dur: Duration (seconds) of sliding one cell, default 1.65 — at 0 it jumps without easing. Original phone vertical pillar .9
options.dir: With right it moves right (initially standing one set-length to the left) · with down it moves downward in vertical mode. Default left (up)
options.axis: If y, rises one cell at a time vertically — the panel needs a height
options.delay: Extra wait before the first pause (sec), default 0
options.wait: When play, it starts once the fx:play event reaches the element — use it to run after the loader clears (original is .12s after the loader)
options.--fx-item: Cell width (css variable), default 15vw — when vertical, the cell sets its own height
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Band — its first child is one set of cells (like a ul holding the cells), and the part appends one more identical set
options.[data-fx-part=set]: (optional) when singling out one set of cells within the strip — if absent, the strip’s first child
options.hover: With stop, while the hand is over the panel the next step is deferred, and after it leaves it rests (hold) once and then walks again (Studio carousel data-hover-stop)
options.[data-fx-part=prev] · [data-fx-part=next: (Optional) Prev/next buttons inside the panel — pressing moves one slot immediately (same dur and curve), and the walking tempo restarts at the end of that step. Prev on the first slot silently jumps to the end of the cloned set, then steps back one
